prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 10 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: Sebastian's apartment, living room, Day, soft bright sunlight through the floor-to-ceiling window.
Image 1: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S4
Image 2: the character sheet of Daniel (30)
Image 3: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 9: the prop folder; use only structure, material, and color
Image 10: the prop two coins; use only structure, material, and color
Image 11: the prop Sebastian's phone; use only structure, material, and color
Image 12: the prop Daniel's phone; use only structure, material, and color
Image 13: the prop car key; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Sebastian sits in the dining chair on the couch side of the round dining table, facing the kitchenette, one hand on the closed folder. Daniel stands on the kitchenette side of the round dining table facing him, his phone in his hand. On the table: the closed folder, Sebastian's phone face down and the two coins beside it.
Panel 1: Medium two-shot, locked-off, eye-level, from the bookshelves side. Sebastian sits at the dining table; Daniel slips his phone away, takes a black car key fob from his pocket and sets it beside the two coins.
Panel 2: Close-up insert, overhead shot, locked-off, on the table top. The black car key fob lies next to the two silver quarters.
Panel 3: Medium shot, locked-off, eye-level, on Sebastian. Sebastian picks up the car key and turns it once between his fingers.
Panel 4: Medium shot, dirty single on Daniel with Sebastian's shoulder at the frame edge, eye-level. Daniel folds his hands in front of him, a faint doubtful look behind his glasses.
Panel 5: Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off, eye-level, on Sebastian. Sebastian gives a slow, private smile.
Panel 6: Close-up insert, high angle, following Sebastian's hand. Sebastian's hand scoops the two coins off the table and slides them into his chino pocket.
Panel 7: Medium shot, low angle, tilting up with Sebastian as he rises, from the bookshelves side. Sebastian stands up from the dining chair, pocketing his phone with the car key in hand; Daniel looks at him across the table.
Panel 8: Close-up, slow push in, eye-level, on Sebastian's face. Sebastian's eyes turn hard and certain as he looks toward the front door.
Panel 9: Medium shot, clean single, locked-off, eye-level, on Daniel. Sebastian is off screen. Daniel straightens up and gives a small knowing nod.
Panel 10: Wide shot, pan following Sebastian from the dining table to the front door, eye-level, from the bookshelves side. Sebastian walks past the charcoal couch to the front door on the left wall, opens it and leaves; Daniel stays at the kitchenette side of the dining table.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
